speaker: Orac
text: Good news: the distribution grid is working.

speaker: Jason
text: And the bad news?

speaker: Rob
text: It has recognized an unauthorized removal. Stay below the rim. The upper batteries cannot track us in the channel.

speaker: Orac
text: Two security needles. Unmanned. Amber lines mean a laser lock. Break away before they turn red.

speaker: Rob
text: Service bridge ahead. Pass below it. Your hull will fit.

speaker: Orac
text: Entering the covered section. Keep the nose steady; there is less room above us.

speaker: Rob
text: Wall laser turrets. The amber line locks before the burst. Move off it, or use solid cover.

speaker: Orac
text: That is a closed gate, Rob.

speaker: Rob
text: A service lock. I can request a maintenance opening. Center the ship.

speaker: Rob
text: The opening is clear. Continue.

speaker: Orac
text: Relay marker recorded. Broken machinery ahead. Watch the gaps and your altitude. Two more wall turrets in the final cut.

speaker: Orac
text: Tracking coverage is falling away. Stay low until we clear the last pylon.

speaker: Rob
text: Clear of the batteries. You can climb.

speaker: Jason
text: Next time we take something that is already unplugged.

speaker: Jason
text: Wreckage ahead. Pass left.

speaker: Jason
text: Wreckage ahead. Pass right.

speaker: Jason
text: Hanging wreckage. Dive below.

speaker: Jason
text: Fallen wreckage. Climb above.

speaker: Orac
text: Hull lost. Press Enter or Space to retry the last checkpoint.

speaker: Rob
text: Clear of the batteries. Climb through the cloud layer; I have a local orbital track.

speaker: Orac
text: Sublight is stable. Hold above the tracking grid while we prepare the exterior repair.

speaker: Orac
text: Local orbit established. The component is secure. No tracking contacts.

speaker: Rob
text: That was the last repair item. The outer drive housing must be isolated and depressurized before we fit it. We do that here, in vacuum.

speaker: Jason
text: Hold this orbit. We finish the repairs before we try to leave.
